findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Use of weak cryptographic hashing algorithm
 * @description Using weak cryptographic hash algorithms like MD5 or SHA1 for security purposes can compromise data integrity
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/weak-crypto-hash
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-327
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("hashlib").getMember(["md5", "sha1"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("hashlib").getMember("new").getACall() and
    exists(DataFlow::Node arg |
      arg = call.getArg(0) and
      arg.asExpr().(StringLiteral).getText() in ["md5", "sha1"]
    )
  )
select call, "Use of weak cryptographic hash algorithm that may be vulnerable to collision attacks."
findings.hypothesis: Check for use of weak cryptographic hash algorithms (MD5, SHA1) that could be vulnerable to collision attacks
